cohort: 8 patients with OHVIRA diagnosis and at least 1 documented pregnancy
finding: Patients with OHVIRA had a higher incidence of spontaneous abortion, preterm birth, breech presentation, and cesarean delivery compared with the general population.
mod_finding: Women with OHVIRA have a higher incidence of cesarean delivery compared to the general population.
gest_age: Average gestational age at delivery was 37 2/7 weeks
